stories.title: Bar Council warns students to verify law college credentials
stories.summary: The Bar Council of India has issued an advisory urging students and parents to independently verify the affiliation and approval status of law colleges before enrolling. The move follows a Supreme Court directive aimed at curbing institutions that make misleading claims regarding their legal authority to operate.

stories.title: Medical school seats remain vacant as costs climb
stories.summary: Medical education costs in India have created a barrier where affordability outweighs academic eligibility. Annual tuition fees for Deemed Universities now reach up to 30 lakh, with total course costs hitting 1.7 crore. Many qualified students are opting out, leaving seats empty.

stories.title: Telangana Board releases tentative 2027 exam schedule
stories.summary: The Telangana Board of Intermediate Education has released its tentative timetable for 2027 public examinations. First-year exams are scheduled from February 24 to March 19, with second-year exams running from February 25 to March 20. The schedule is available on the board website.

stories.title: UGC NET December 2026 exam dates announced
stories.summary: The University Grants Commission has scheduled the December 2026 National Eligibility Test for December 14 to 18 and December 21. Exams will be held in two daily shifts. The commission recently published a list of 32 fake universities, with Delhi hosting 12 of them.

stories.title: Assam sets Class 10 exam date following flood delays
stories.summary: The Assam State School Education Board will begin Class 10 final exams on February 25. The schedule follows an extension of the academic year to compensate for classroom time lost to floods and Census activities. Education Minister Ranoj Pegu confirmed the dates on social media.

stories.title: UPTET 2027 registration opens November 24
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission has announced that UPTET 2027 exams will take place on February 26 and 27. Registration begins November 24 and closes December 23. A correction window for applicants will remain open until December 27.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh Board releases 2027 exam timetable
stories.summary: The Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education has released its 2027 exam schedule. Class 10 exams will run from March 13 to April 5 in a single morning shift. The exams will begin with third language papers and conclude with Music, Driving, and Painting.

stories.title: SSC releases exam city slips for 2026 sub-inspector candidates
stories.summary: The Staff Selection Commission has released exam city intimation slips for candidates appearing in the 2025 Paper-II examination for Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces. Candidates can access their details and admission certificates through the official commission login module.

stories.title: SBI Clerk Prelims 2026 results declared
stories.summary: The State Bank of India has declared results for the Junior Associate preliminary examination held in September 2026. The test consisted of three sections covering English, numerical ability, and reasoning. Candidates can access their Phase 1 marks through the official bank website.

stories.title: Haryana Board announces December 2026 HTET dates
stories.summary: The Board of School Education, Haryana, will hold the Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test on December 26 and 27. Level III exams are set for the first day, followed by Levels I and II on the second. The board has introduced new rules for candidates this year.

stories.title: NEET SS 2026 registration closes today
stories.summary: The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences closes registration for the NEET Super Specialty exam today, November 18. The exam is scheduled for December, with a correction window opening November 20. Admit cards are expected to be released in December.

stories.title: NTA releases RIMCEE 2026 exam city slips
stories.summary: The National Testing Agency has released exam city slips for the Rashtriya Indian Military College Entrance Examination. The Stage 1 exam is scheduled for December 6, spanning four and a half hours. The paper consists of 150 questions across three subjects.

stories.title: Federal judge strikes down student visa duration limit
stories.summary: A federal judge has vacated a Department of Homeland Security rule that sought to cap F-1 and J-1 student visas at four years. The ruling restores the duration of status policy, which allows international students to remain in the country until their academic programs are complete.

stories.title: Courts block Trump administration visa and internship restrictions
stories.summary: Federal judges have blocked two August 2026 directives that limited student visa stays to four years and restricted eligibility for Curricular Practical Training. The courts ruled the policies were arbitrary and capricious, noting they unfairly restricted academic mobility for over two million participants.

stories.title: Federal courts stay student visa and internship restrictions
stories.summary: Federal judges have set aside a rule limiting F-1 students to four-year admission periods and stayed guidance that restricted Curricular Practical Training to mandatory degree requirements. These policies cannot be enforced nationwide while litigation continues. Employers are advised to review their current internship documentation.

stories.title: Federal Judge Strikes Down Rule Limiting International Students' Stays - The EDU Ledger
Judge blocks new restrictions on international student work
stories.summary: A federal judge has issued a preliminary injunction blocking enforcement of August 2026 guidance that limited Curricular Practical Training to graduation requirements. The ruling temporarily prevents the administration from restricting how international students authorize work experience related to their fields of study.

stories.title: Ireland grants visas to 48 Gazan students
stories.summary: Ireland’s justice minister has granted visas to 48 Gazan students after initially refusing their applications. The decision follows a High Court order to review the case of a student whose application contained significant errors. The court case is expected to have implications for future applications.

stories.title: Ireland grants visas to 48 Gaza students
stories.summary: The Irish government has granted visas to 48 students in Gaza following a High Court order to reconsider previous refusals. While all students hold scholarships, only 20 are currently scheduled for evacuation on Monday. The government notes it has no control over the evacuation process itself.

stories.title: Federal judge rejects student visa time limits
stories.summary: A federal judge has struck down a Trump administration plan that would have restricted the duration of stay for international students. The ruling preserves the long-standing duration of status policy, allowing students to remain in the country for the entirety of their academic programs while enrolled.

stories.title: Trump administration loses again: Court reverses limits on international student visa duration - Daily Cal
Court upholds duration of status for international students
stories.summary: A Massachusetts judge has ruled against a Department of Homeland Security policy that sought to end the duration of status for international students. The decision allows students to remain in the U.S. for their entire program rather than reapplying for visas every four years.

stories.title: Gazan students face evacuation uncertainty
stories.summary: Ireland has approved 48 visa appeals for students in Gaza, but only 20 are currently set to evacuate on Monday. Phoenix Law warns that students who miss the flight may lose their academic placements, as evacuation decisions remain with Israeli and Jordanian authorities.

stories.title: Another Trump effort to drive international students away - Dallas News
Tennessee opens scholarship applications for 2027
stories.summary: The Tennessee Department of Education has announced dates for its 2027-28 Education Freedom Scholarship Program. Renewal applications open December 8, while new applicants may apply starting January 12. The program provides state-funded scholarships for private school tuition regardless of household income or ZIP code.

stories.title: Tennessee sets scholarship application deadlines
stories.summary: Tennessee families can begin renewing Education Freedom Scholarships on December 8, with new applications opening January 12, 2027. All submissions must be completed by January 29. Students who were unsuccessful in previous cycles are classified as new applicants and must wait for the January window.

stories.title: Tennessee details 2027-28 voucher application timeline
stories.summary: The Tennessee Department of Education has confirmed that renewal applications for its Education Freedom Scholarship program open in December, with new applications starting January 12. All applicants face a January 29 deadline. The program provides state-funded scholarships for private school tuition.

stories.title: UWM opens scholarship and financial aid cycle
stories.summary: UW-Milwaukee has launched its scholarship awarding cycle for the 2027-28 academic year. Students are encouraged to complete the Panther Scholarship Portal and the FAFSA to determine eligibility for financial aid. Awards are based on criteria including academic merit, financial need, leadership, and service.

stories.title: Northampton school offers funded sixth form places
stories.summary: Bosworth Independent School in Northampton is accepting applications for four remaining fully funded sixth form scholarships for September 2027. The awards are available to British or dual-nationality students in Northamptonshire who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement and the potential to excel in their studies.

stories.title: DST invites applications for science scholarships
stories.summary: The Department of Science and Technology has opened applications for its 2026 INSPIRE-SHE programme, offering 12,000 scholarships to science students. The initiative supports undergraduate and postgraduate studies based on performance in national-level examinations. The deadline for applications is December 7, 2026.

stories.title: Girls On Campus offers leadership scholarship
stories.summary: Girls On Campus is accepting applications for a $1,500 scholarship for female students planning to attend U.S. colleges in fall 2027. The program prioritizes everyday leadership, initiative, and community commitment over traditional academic awards or major achievements.

stories.title: UCT offers Mastercard scholarships for African leaders
stories.summary: The University of Cape Town is inviting applications for the 2027 Healthy Futures Mastercard Scholarship. The program supports emerging African leaders pursuing a Master of Philosophy in Inclusive Innovation, focusing on health equity, social justice, and the transformation of healthcare systems.

stories.title: Uniqlo announces global management program in Tokyo
stories.summary: Fast Retailing is accepting applications for its 2027 Global Management Program in Tokyo. The six-day intensive course offers undergraduate and postgraduate students an opportunity to study the fashion-retailing industry while learning from global business executives and industry experts.

stories.title: UAH opens cybersecurity scholarship applications
stories.summary: The University of Alabama in Huntsville is accepting applications for cybersecurity scholarships for the fall 2027 semester. The program, funded by the National Science Foundation and the Department of War, covers tuition, fees, and a cost-of-living stipend for students in cybersecurity-related degrees.

stories.title: Borlaug program offers PhD scholarships for African researchers
stories.summary: The NAPB Borlaug Scholars-Africa Programme is offering six scholarships to African PhD students in plant breeding. The two-year program provides financial support, international exposure, and professional mentorship to nurture the next generation of agricultural scientists at African universities.

stories.title: Oregon cooperative opens 2027 scholarship applications
stories.summary: The Oregon Trail Electric Cooperative is accepting scholarship applications for the 2027 academic year. Local students, including high school graduates and current college attendees, may apply for various awards, including a $5,000 trade school scholarship. The deadline for applications is March 1.

stories.title: King Abdulaziz University leads regional sustainability rankings
stories.summary: King Abdulaziz University placed first among Saudi and Arab universities in the QS World University Rankings: Sustainability 2027, reaching 166th globally. The university earned an overall score of 87.8 points, reflecting improvements in environmental, social, and governance performance. It advanced 28 positions from the previous year.

stories.title: Mendel University tops Czech open access rankings
stories.summary: Mendel University in Brno achieved a 73.5% open access rate for publications between 2021 and 2024, leading the 2026 Leiden Ranking for the indicator. The university outperformed Palacký University Olomouc and Masaryk University. The institution describes the result as a milestone in sharing scientific knowledge.

stories.title: Türkiye ranks second globally in interdisciplinary science
stories.summary: Türkiye placed second worldwide in the Times Higher Education 2027 Interdisciplinary Science Rankings with 89 universities, according to the Council of Higher Education. The country follows India, which had 102 institutions listed. The number of Turkish universities in the global top 200 rose to 13.

stories.title: Guardian University Guide ranks top Scottish institutions
stories.summary: The Guardian University Guide 2027 has released its rankings for Scottish universities. The guide evaluates institutions based on eight scores, including student feedback from the annual National Student Survey, aiming to measure the student experience rather than focusing exclusively on academic research output.

stories.title: Gazipur Agricultural University leads national agri rankings
stories.summary: Gazipur Agricultural University ranked as the top agricultural university in Bangladesh in the Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2027. The institution placed in the 351 to 400 global band. The ranking evaluates interdisciplinary research outcomes, institutional support, and funding across over 1,000 universities worldwide.

stories.title: University of Bucharest improves in interdisciplinary research rankings
stories.summary: The University of Bucharest is ranked in the 251 to 300 band in the Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2027. This marks an improvement from the 401 to 500 band in the previous edition. The ranking assessed the interdisciplinary scientific research performance of 1,058 universities across 102 countries.

stories.title: Time and Statista profile 5,900 American leaders
stories.summary: Time and Statista have traced the paths of 5,900 American leaders across sectors including academia, business, and government. The report notes that while women represent a majority of the college-educated labor force, they held 16% of CFO roles and 7% of CEO positions in large companies during 2023.

stories.title: 37 Egyptian universities make 2027 Times Higher Education interdisciplinary science rankings - Society - Egypt - Ahram O
University of Sharjah retains top UAE spot in interdisciplinary rankings
stories.summary: The University of Sharjah ranked 69th globally in the Times Higher Education Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2027, maintaining its position as the leading institution in the UAE for the second consecutive year. The rankings evaluated 1,058 higher education institutions, including seven based in the UAE.

stories.title: University of Wollongong improves sustainability score
stories.summary: The University of Wollongong increased its overall score in the 2027 QS Sustainability Rankings to 88.8, up from 87.4. The university is now ranked equal 151st globally and 18th in Australia. The rankings assess institutional efforts in environmental and social impact, research, and governance.

stories.title: Visva-Bharati University faculty protest professor suspension
stories.summary: The Visva-Bharati University Faculty Association has alleged that the suspension of Professor Sudipta Bhattacharyya is intended to intimidate dissenting teachers. Vice-Chancellor Prabir Kumar Ghosh ordered the immediate suspension on November 17. The university has stated that specific charges will be provided in a future charge sheet.

stories.title: HUTECH ranks among Vietnam's top five for sustainability
stories.summary: HUTECH University of Technology placed 835th globally in the QS World University Rankings: Sustainability 2027. The university ranked fifth among 15 Vietnamese institutions included in the list. The school stated the result reflects its commitment to integrating sustainability into its higher education approach.

stories.title: Wichita State reports decline in international enrollment
stories.summary: International student enrollment at Wichita State University has decreased, according to university staff. The decline follows a national trend of a 9% drop in international students reported by the Associated Press. Advisors cited high costs and visa processing delays as primary factors for the lower numbers.

stories.title: Japanese firms maintain language requirements for international hires
stories.summary: Japanese companies are increasingly seeking to hire international graduates to address labor shortages. Despite the demand, many candidates face difficulties securing employment due to high employer standards regarding Japanese language proficiency. Students attended a recent job fair to explore opportunities available after graduation.

stories.title: NMSU hosts international student gathering
stories.summary: New Mexico State University held an international student event on November 13 to provide community for those spending holidays away from home. Organized by campus departments, the gathering offered food and activities. Organizers noted that travel costs and other barriers often prevent international students from returning home.

stories.title: Garrett College celebrates international student body
stories.summary: Garrett College hosted an event to recognize 17 international students from 12 nations. The celebration included sample dishes from the students' home countries and discussions regarding cultural traditions. The event was part of the Joan Crawford Lecture Series and was open to the general public.

stories.title: Leicester students plan youth strikes over budget concerns
stories.summary: Students at the University of Leicester are planning to join youth strikes on November 20. The union is protesting the government's Autumn Budget, citing concerns over student loan debt, higher education funding, and reforms to the graduate visa scheme which they claim discourage international students.

stories.title: University of Alberta manages sponsored student program
stories.summary: Olga Paladi leads the Sponsored Student Program at the University of Alberta. The role involves acting as a central contact for sponsoring organizations and students, managing the application process, monitoring academic progress, and connecting students to campus services such as accessibility and residence support.

stories.title: TMU student navigates study permit refusal during final exams
stories.summary: Incoming Chemical Engineering student Jenny Vy received a study permit refusal during her final International Baccalaureate exams. The university's International Student Support office is assisting students with the application process as refusal rates shift. Vy reported feeling emotionless upon receiving the news while continuing her studies.

stories.title: Northern Territory marks ten years of international student awards
stories.summary: The Northern Territory announced five winners at the 2026 Study NT International Student Awards on 19 November. Minister Robyn Cahill stated the awards reflect the government's commitment to attracting and retaining international talent. The event highlights the role of students in the local workforce and community.

stories.title: UCU initiates third academic boycott of Goldsmiths in four years
stories.summary: The University and College Union has called for an academic boycott of Goldsmiths, University of London, citing planned job cuts. The university described the action as counterproductive to its reputation. Members are instructed to avoid research projects, conferences, and external examination roles at the institution.

stories.title: Think tank criticizes Home Office treatment of UK universities
stories.summary: Policy Exchange director Iain Mansfield told the UUKi conference that the Home Office is treating elite institutions and business schools as a single group. He argued that the sector's attempt to present a unified front has resulted in all universities being penalized by the government.

stories.title: International scholars study urban agriculture at Durham College
stories.summary: Four scholars from Tanzania, Rwanda, Honduras and Ecuador are completing a leadership certificate at Durham College. Supported by the Queen Elizabeth Scholars program and World Vision Canada, the students are working with staff at the Barrett Centre to explore sustainable urban agriculture practices.

stories.title: University of Alberta connects students through holiday program
stories.summary: The Share the Cheer program at the University of Alberta matches international students with community members for holiday visits between 19 December and 3 January. The initiative aims to provide company for students remaining on campus during the winter closure while their families are abroad.

research.title: Management of Behavioral Addictions via Artificial Intelligence based Digital Technologies
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Behavioral addictions, such as problematic gaming, gambling, social media use, and online shopping, have emerged as a growing global concern with significant psychological, social, and economic consequences. Traditional assessment and treatment approaches, while clinically grounded, often. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Mapping the AI Supply Chain: Dependencies, Vulnerabilities, and Market Concentration in the AI Ecosystem
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI systems are built across many organizations that contribute models, data, compute, capital, talent, and other assets. While the layers of the AI stack are relatively well understood, the relationships between actors and components across layers. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Meme Template Identification in the Wild: Comparing Methods for Semi-Open-Set Recognition
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Image-with-text memes are a dominant form of online communication, and much of their spread happens through meme templates which are recurring visual formats that users adapt with new text or imagery. Most prior work scores memes. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Record Sufficiency: What a Decision Record Must Preserve When an Unsettled Claim Becomes an Operative Status
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Organisations keep evidence, logs and approvals, but often not the step by which an unsettled claim became an operative status, such as an accepted label or a released image, so later readers cannot tell what the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Same Model, Different People: Numerical Execution Contracts and the Reproducibility of Fairness Audits
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Fairness audits treat a trained model as a fixed decision function, but the arithmetic that evaluates it is part of that function. This study holds the model, records, threshold and audit code fixed and varies the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The Nuclear Decision-Making Benchmark: Evaluating Frontier LLM Tendencies in Escalation, Proliferation, Non-Proliferation, and Arms Control
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are entering defense and national-security workflows. Seven of the nine nuclear-armed states have committed to keeping humans in control of decisions to use nuclear weapons, but LLMs may still shape the assessments. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: When Do LLMs Model the Right Target? Problem Formulation in High-Stakes Risk Prediction
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI is increasingly used to assist with data science tasks, yet fundamental questions remain about its ability to correctly formulate analytical problems. We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) can formulate prediction problems when. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Equitable funding for inclusive big team science
research.summary: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 16 November 2026, doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02638-7 Big team science seeks to make research more inclusive, but the cost of recruiting representative samples can vary markedly across countries. This risks reinforcing the very inequalities these collaborations seek to address. Pooling resources and asking funders to contribute.
